summary_en: MSE Inc., a holding company controlled by Representative Director Kuroda Shigeo and his family, launched a tender offer for all common shares of Shobunsha Holdings at ¥752 per share from November 9 to December 21, 2026. The minimum acquisition target is 6,633,100 shares, which would bring MSE's ownership to 66.36%. The board recommended shareholders tender their shares to achieve delisting and privatization.
title_en: Notice of Implementation of MBO and Recommendation of Tender Offer
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Shobunsha Holdings' board of directors expressed support for a tender offer by MSE Inc., a holding company established in October 2023 and wholly owned by Representative Director Kuroda Shigeo and his family members. MSE currently holds 3,428,500 shares (19.14% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) of Shobunsha, while Kuroda personally holds an additional 1,879,700 shares (10.49%). The tender offer will run from November 9 to December 21, 2026, at a fixed price of ¥752 per share. The minimum number of shares to be acquired is 6,633,100, which would bring MSE's ownership to 66.36% following the transaction.

This transaction is structured as a management buyout (MBO) with the stated objective of privatizing Shobunsha and delisting it from the Tokyo Standard Exchange. The tender offer applies to all common shares except those held by Shobunsha as treasury stock and those held directly by Kuroda (whose shares will not be tendered by agreement). The board recommended that shareholders tender their shares, acknowledging that the transaction would result in the company's shares becoming non-public and the company being delisted. The purchase price of ¥752 per share and the transaction timeline were disclosed; no upper limit on the number of shares to be acquired was set.
